name: algo-training
description: AlgoPilot - local-first Codeforces / AtCoder / Luogu training dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @algo/server" "npm run dev -w @algo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @algo/web && npm run build -w @algo/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @algo/server && npm run typecheck -w @algo/web
